original_object.reason: The statement says an unseparated cluster “requires the contour-count route,” but neither the proof nor any supplied dependency establishes that claim. The bound only addresses a separated simple eigenvalue, and other cluster perturbation methods exist.

Step 4.1 misuses F5: λ is an eigenvalue of A+E, whereas only A is assumed monodromy. Arbitrary E need not produce a monodromy matrix and may even make A+E singular. The Floquet conclusion requires A+E to be monodromy.
